title: Guess the Decade
words: guess the decade synth melody retro 80s synthwave cassette radio music
style: clean flat vector synthwave poster art, crisp geometric shapes, a big striped sunset sun, layered mountain silhouettes, a glowing perspective grid floor, smooth gradients, subtle glow, no texture

frame.scene: a retro 1980s synthwave night: deep indigo sky with a few stars, a huge striped orange-to-pink sunset sun sitting on a horizon of violet mountain silhouettes, a glowing magenta perspective grid floor below
frame.focal: a round glowing cyan play button in front of the sun, ringed with a soft sound-wave halo
frame.hud: two small blank dark rounded plaques side by side at the top
frame.controls: four wide stacked dark translucent rounded answer bars with thin cyan outlines over the grid floor

wordmark.lettering: 1980s synthwave chrome title lettering: bold italic letters with a hot pink to orange sunset gradient fill, a cyan neon outline and a chrome bevel, like a retro arcade logo

backdrop.scene: the same retro synthwave night: deep indigo starry sky, a huge striped orange-to-pink sunset sun on a horizon of violet mountain silhouettes, a glowing magenta perspective grid floor below
backdrop.calm: the lower half over the grid floor is calm and dark enough for answer bars, and the band around the sun stays clear for one play button

sprites.set: Every subject is a glowing neon retro object drawn in the same synthwave poster style, chunky and simple, readable at a small size.
